decisions.identity_hint: BlurPool implementation behind reviewed ERC1967Proxy storage owner
decisions.mapping_basis: The blocker runtime family is generic ERC1967Proxy bytecode shared by multiple applications, so it must not be mapped by proxy runtime hash. Frozen callTracer evidence for storage owner 0x0000000000a39bb272e79075ade125fd351887ac delegates to implementation family 3b52a3f0... identified by verified source as contracts/pool/BlurPool.sol:BlurPool. BlurPool exposes deposit, withdraw, balanceOf, totalSupply, and transferFrom. Map that proxy storage owner explicitly to the implementation profile and reuse wrapped-native-token for the wrapped/deposit-withdraw fungible dependency surface.
decisions.review_conclusion: Safe owner-scoped implementation mapping for BlurPool; no generic ERC1967Proxy semantic alias is created.
decisions.semantic_notes: Explicit owner scope prevents the same generic proxy runtime family from conflating BlurPool with BlurExchange.
